_comment: Leatherworking recipes. Leather drops directly from beasts via Skinning (entities/skinning_drops.py) — it is NOT processed like ore->bar. Leatherworking uses the raw leather (and hides/armor kits as intermediates) to craft gear. Recipe structure mirrors blacksmithing_manager.py: 'armor' kind outputs go through LootGenerator.generate_armor_piece, 'material' kind outputs are stackable materials (armor kits, upgrade kits). WoW Classic bracket: Apprentice 1-75 (scrap/light), Journeyman 75-150 (medium/heavy), Expert 150-225 (thick/rugged + Frontier tiers 7-10), Artisan 225-300 (Frontier tiers 11-18). Stat templates: LW gear is mail armor, agility-focused for hunters/shaman. Every output carries 'material_tier' for upgrade kit matching (upgrade_manager.py).

item.name: Manticore Hide Helm
item.flavor_text: Manticore hide turns a blade by habit. The beast turned a few in its time.

item.name: Manticore Hide Spaulders
item.flavor_text: The tail barbs were kept. Somebody always asks.

item.name: Manticore Hide Tunic
item.flavor_text: Thick at the chest, loose at the arms, built for something with claws.

item.name: Manticore Hide Bracers
item.flavor_text: Stitched with the beast's own sinew. It holds.

item.name: Manticore Hide Grips
item.flavor_text: Rough palms, sure fingers.

item.name: Manticore Hide Belt
item.flavor_text: Room for six knives. People always find a seventh.

item.name: Manticore Hide Leggings
item.flavor_text: Creased at the knee like it's ready to pounce.

item.name: Manticore Hide Boots
item.flavor_text: Soft soles, hard toes.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Coif
item.flavor_text: Scales from the beast's mane, set in rings.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Hauberk
item.flavor_text: Heavier than it looks, lighter than it was on the manticore.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Gauntlets
item.flavor_text: Every knuckle a scale, every scale an argument.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Girdle
item.flavor_text: A healer's belt with a hunter's patience.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Legguards
item.flavor_text: Good for long walks and short arguments.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Sabatons
item.flavor_text: They ring a little on stone, like distant rain.

item.name: Chimera Hide Jerkin
item.flavor_text: Three heads' worth of hide, and it still argues with itself.

item.name: Chimera Hide Leggings
item.flavor_text: Built for a hunter who's half beast already.

item.name: Chimera-Scale Hauberk
item.flavor_text: Every scale was taken from a chimera that wanted it back.

item.name: Chimera-Scale Legguards
item.flavor_text: Cool as river stone, warm when it counts.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Brigandine
item.flavor_text: Scales riveted over leather. Quiet enough, tough enough.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Spaulders
item.flavor_text: The mane scales stand up when you're angry. So do you.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Bracers
item.flavor_text: Snug at the wrist, so the string never catches.

item.name: Manticore Mending Vest
item.flavor_text: Soft hide, dyed green, with a pocket for every herb.

item.name: Manticore Mending Leggings
item.flavor_text: Patched at the knees from a lot of kneeling beside people.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Tidemail
item.flavor_text: Blue-glazed scales that run like water when you move.

item.name: Manticore Wildstalker Jerkin
item.flavor_text: For the ones who fight with a blade in one hand and a spell in the other.

item.name: Manticore Wildstalker Leggings
item.flavor_text: Fur-lined, spell-stitched, and quiet in long grass.

item.name: Manticore-Scale Huntsman's Vest
item.flavor_text: Scale on the front, pockets on the back, a quiver hook on the side.

item.name: Manticore Brute's Harness
item.flavor_text: More strap than shirt, and the straps are doing a lot of work.

item.name: Manticore Brute's Leggings
item.flavor_text: Thick enough to kick through a door. Several doors.

item.name: Chimera-Scale Helm
item.flavor_text: A crest of chimera spines, and a face plate with three expressions.

item.name: Chimera Mending Robe
item.flavor_text: Three hides, three colours, one very calm healer inside.

item.name: Chimera Wildstalker Tunic
item.flavor_text: Half beast, half spell, all of it pointed at someone.
